vectorDB.text: Brand Guideline Illicit: Naught but authentic self Step into the world of "illicit ", a local clothing brand that offers a variety of fashionable accessories and artistic apparels for those who seek to express their unique individuality. It all started in 2018. In a sea of clothing brand in casual fits, we saw a lack of originality in Myanmar fashion industry that left customers yearning for more than worn out and cookie cutter styles in their Daily life. We set out to fill this gap by offering a refreshing alternative that combines affordable artistic flair. It's our belief that fashion is a medium for self expression and each individual deserves to stand out among the crowd without falling pit of unoriginality. To arrive this end, we took a daring step to reinvent casual apparels and other accessories infusing the simplicity with artistically unique designs that resonate with one's own personal identity. We forge our products with passion and commitment to reflect your inner uniqueness. " Illicit; serve as a bridge spanning you and your timeless authentic self " Products PRODUCT NAME: Bon Kan Nway SLOGAN: Descendants of Rebels DESCRIPTION: Bon Kan Nway is a tunic made from Inlay Shan cotton. Its design is a homage to previous revolutions in Burma. The back of the garment features newsprint stories from the1962 student uprisings. The tag on the sleeve features handwriting from a present-day activist, Tayzar San, and highlight significant dates across Myanmar's political history. The Bon Kan Nway tunic serves as a symbol of multi-generational struggle against military dictatorship. PRODUCT NAME: Trauma SLOGAN: "The flowers that remain after all we have endured" DESCRIPTION: From the start we mean the trauma as an individual pain of us. But since the coup, it became an expression of the pain and hope for a brighter future of the whole nation. Even we had worst experience, we still resisted and survived. PRODUCT NAME: JAPANESE INSPIRED CARDIGAN DESCRIPTION: Where simplicity meets style, this comfort casual shirt from illicit is designed for those who appreciate effortless fashion. Crafted from premium combed cotton sourced from Shan State, Myanmar, it delivers unmatched comfort and quality. As a tribute to Myanmar's rich heritage, the shirt features elegant patchwork made from traditional Burmese longyi, blending cultural significance with modern design. Perfect for those who value being fashionable yet simple, this shirt embodies timeless style with a unique cultural touch. PRODUCT NAME: LAZY SUMMER DAYS TEE DESCRIPTION: This tee was born from the emptiness we felt during the ca time when the future seemed lost, and we had no energy to move forward. It speaks to that quiet struggle, where summer doesn't bring joy or hope, just a feeling of inertia. We keep moving, not because we expect better, but because we have to. Simple, honest, and raw, this tee is for everyone who carries the weight of hard times but keeps going anyway-a reminder that even in the darkest moments, we endure.
